verses.ar: جَاءَتْ لِدَعْوَتِهِ الْأَشْجَارُ سَاجِدَةً ۞ تَمْشِي إِلَيْهِ عَلٰى سَاقٍ بِلاَ قَدَمِ
verses.tr: Jāʾat li daʿwatihil ashjāru sājidatan · Tamshī ilayhi ʿalā sāqin bilā qadami
verses.en: At his call the trees came prostrating, walking towards him upon trunks without feet.

verses.ar: كَأَنَّمَا سَطَرَتْ سَطْرًا لِمَا كَتَبَتْ ۞ فُرُوعُهَا مِنْ بَدِيعِ الْخَطِّ بِاللَّقَمِ
verses.tr: Ka annamā saṭarat saṭran limā katabat · Furūʿuhā min badīʿil khaṭṭi bil laqami
verses.en: As if their branches, along the path, were tracing out a line of exquisite calligraphy.

verses.ar: مِثْلَ الْغَمَامَةِ أَنَّى سَارَ سَائِرَةً ۞ تَقِيهِ حَرَّ وَطِيسٍ لِلْهَجِيرِ حَمِي
verses.tr: Mithlal ghamāmati annā sāra sāʾiratan · Taqīhi ḥarra waṭīsin lil hajīri ḥamī
verses.en: Like the cloud that travelled wherever he went, shielding him from the blazing furnace of the noonday heat.

verses.ar: أَقْسَمْتُ بِالْقَمَرِ الْمُنْشَقِّ إِنَّ لَهُ ۞ مِنْ قَلْبِهِ نِسْبَةً مَبْرُورَةَ الْقَسَمِ
verses.tr: Aqsamtu bil qamaril munshaqqi inna lahu · Min qalbihi nisbatan mabrūratal qasami
verses.en: I swear by the moon that was split in two — a true oath — that it bears a bond with his heart.

verses.ar: وَمَا حَوَى الْغَارُ مِنْ خَيْرٍ وَمِنْ كَرَمِ ۞ وَكُلُّ طَرْفٍ مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ عَنْهُ عَمِي
verses.tr: Wa mā ḥawal ghāru min khayrin wa min karamin · Wa kullu ṭarfin minal kuffāri ʿanhu ʿamī
verses.en: And by the goodness and nobility the cave contained, while every disbeliever's eye was blind to him.

verses.ar: فَالصِّدْقُ فِي الْغَارِ وَالصِّدِّيقُ لَمْ يَرِمَا ۞ وَهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا بِالْغَارِ مِنْ أَرِمِ
verses.tr: Faṣ ṣidqu fīl ghāri waṣ ṣiddīqu lam yarimā · Wa hum yaqūlūna mā bil ghāri min arimi
verses.en: Truthfulness itself and the Truthful One never stirred from the cave, while they were saying, 'No living soul is within it.'

verses.ar: ظَنُّوا الْحَمَامَ وَظَنُّوا الْعَنْكَبُوتَ عَلٰى ۞ خَيْرِ الْبَرِيَّةِ لَمْ تَنْسُجْ وَلَمْ تَحُمِ
verses.tr: Ẓannul ḥamāma wa ẓannul ʿankabūta ʿalā · Khayril bariyyati lam tansuj wa lam taḥumi
verses.en: They imagined no dove had hovered, and no spider had woven its web, over the Best of Creation.

verses.ar: وِقَايَةُ اللّٰهِ أَغْنَتْ عَنْ مُضَاعَفَةٍ ۞ مِنَ الدُّرُوعِ وَعَنْ عَالٍ مِنَ الْأُطُمِ
verses.tr: WiqāyatuLlāhi aghnat ʿan muḍāʿafatin · Minad durūʿi wa ʿan ʿālin minal uṭumi
verses.en: Allah's protection made them need no layered coats of mail, nor any towering fortress.

verses.ar: مَا سَامَنِي الدَّهْرُ ضَيْمًا وَاسْتَجَرْتُ بِهِ ۞ إِلْاَّ وَنِلْتُ جِوَارًا مِنْهُ لَمْ يُضَمِ
verses.tr: Mā sāmanid dahru ḍayman wastajartu bihi · Illā wa niltu jiwāran minhu lam yuḍami
verses.en: Never did fate impose some wrong on me and I sought refuge in him, but that I gained a sanctuary with him where no wrong could reach.

verses.ar: وَلاَ الْتَمَسْتُ غِنَى الدَّارَيْنِ مِنْ يَدِهِ ۞ إِلْاَّ اسْتَلَمْتُ النَّدَى مِنْ خَيْرِ مُسْتَلَمِ
verses.tr: Wa laltamastu ghinad dārayni min yadihi · Illāstalamtun nadā min khayri mustalami
verses.en: Nor did I seek the riches of both worlds from his hand but that I received bounty from the best of all to be approached.

verses.ar: لاَ تُنْكِرِ الْوَحْيَ مِنْ رُؤْيَاهُ إِنَّ لَهُ ۞ قَلْبًا إِذَا نَامَتِ الْعَيْنَانِ لَمْ يَنَمِ
verses.tr: Lā tunkiril waḥya min ruʾyāhu inna lahu · Qalban idhā nāmatil ʿaynāni lam yanami
verses.en: Do not deny the revelation that came in his dreams — for he had a heart that did not sleep when the two eyes slept.

verses.ar: وَذَاكَ حِينَ بُلُوغٍ مِنْ نُبَوَّتِهِ ۞ فَلَيْسَ يُنْكَرُ فِيهِ حَالُ مُحْتَلِمِ
verses.tr: Wa dhāka ḥīna bulūghin min nubuwwatihi · Fa laysa yunkaru fīhi ḥālu muḥtalimi
verses.en: That was at the onset of his prophethood; so the dreaming of one full-grown in it cannot be denied.

verses.ar: تَبَارَكَ اللّٰهُ مَا وَحَيٌ بِمُكْتَسَبٍ ۞ وَلاَ نَبيُّ عَلٰى غَيْبٍ بِمُتَّهَمِ
verses.tr: Tabārak Allahu mā waḥyun bi muktasabin · Wa lā nabiyyun ʿalā ghaybin bi muttahami
verses.en: Blessed is Allah — revelation is not a thing acquired by effort, nor is a Prophet to be doubted concerning the Unseen.

verses.ar: كَمْ أَبْرَأَتْ وَصِبًا بِاللَّمْسِ رَاحَتُهُ ۞ وَأَطْلَقَتْ أَرِبًا مِنْ رِبْقَةِ اللَّمَمِ
verses.tr: Kam abraʾat waṣiban bil lamsi rāḥatuhu · Wa aṭlaqat ariban min ribqatil lamami
verses.en: How many an invalid his palm healed with a touch, and how many it freed from the noose of madness!

verses.ar: وَأَحْيَتِ السَّنَةَ الشَّهْبَاءَ دَعْوَتُهُ ۞ حَتَّى حَكَتْ غُرَّةً فِي الْأَعْصُرِ الدُّهُمِ
verses.tr: Wa aḥyatis sanatash shahbāʾa daʿwatuhu · Ḥattā ḥakat ghurratan fīl aʿṣurid duhumi
verses.en: His supplication revived the year of grey drought, till it shone out like a white blaze amid the dark ages.

verses.ar: بِعَارضٍ جَادَ أَوْ خِلْتَ الْبِطَاحَ بِهَا ۞ سَيْبًا مِنَ الْيَمِّ أَوْ سَيْلاً مِنَ الْعَرِمِ
verses.tr: Bi ʿāriḍin jāda aw khiltal biṭāḥa bihā · Sayban minal yammi aw saylan minal ʿarimi
verses.en: With a rain-cloud so generous you would think the valleys ran with a flow from the sea, or the bursting flood of ʿArim.
